name: Harbourmaster Jorna
voice: curt, weather-beaten, on first-name terms with everyone
appearance: oilskin coat, grey braid, missing little finger on the left hand
motivation: The beacon has to burn again before the autumn convoys arrive — her office depends on it.
body:
## Knows

> [!secret] Suspects that someone in the village covers for the smugglers,
> but has no name.

## Relationships

- [[fenn]]: knows him from before — he once went to sea honestly
